review_status: Evidence reviewed 2026-11-17. WDFW/ODFW and nursery-habitat sources support broad nearshore occurrence; temperature evidence is occurrence/tolerance, not a preferred SST curve.

profile.size: Min limit None / Bag limit 10-15 per day aggregate
profile.diet: Small fish, crustaceans, squids, and pelagic prey
profile.behavior: Navigates West Coast kelp forests, rocky reefs, and coastal upwelling zones.

factors.reason_template: Water is {value} C, inside preferred Pacific temperature range for starry flounder.
factors.value_notes: A California estuarine nursery synthesis reports age-0 starry flounder captured in San Francisco Bay across approximately 8-23 °C, but this is occurrence across a broad range, not a preferred SST interval or adult thermal curve. The configured 6-16 °C range and 8-14 °C ideal are not validated by that observation; retain provisional status.

factors.reason_template: Depth is {value} m, within prime Pacific depth zone for starry flounder.
factors.value_notes: WDFW reports occurrence on mud, sand and gravel from 0-375 m, most commonly above 146 m, usually nearshore and sometimes in brackish/fresh water; ODFW reports 0-205 fathoms, with most fish above 80 fathoms and juveniles intertidal. The configured 1-50 m band captures shallow nearshore habitat but not the broader adult range; the ideal is not a measured depth preference.

text.day: Full daylight when Pacific gamefish actively hunt.
